name: hud_sensor_map_overlay_end_show
description: HudSensorTracker::MapOverlayEndShow stops an active mission-map overlay, captures the current scale as the lerp start, clears x/z target scale, and optionally starts the hide lerp and off sound when a map is loaded.
known_limits: The smoke covers the deterministic no-sound-provider path; sound dispatch remains covered by the accepted zSndSample::PlayA3DSimple provider and should be revisited in the HUD sensor map class pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x416ad0 validates the inactive early return, mapScaleLerpT reset, start/current scale copy, active flag clear, x/z target clear, optional loaded-map running flag and sound-off dispatch.
The native HUD sensor map smoke verifies the active end-show transition, copied start scale, cleared target x/z scale, and no loaded-map sound/running side effect.
